From farm to freight

What happens to each lot between the field and your warehouse.

  1. 1

    Sourcing

    Raw herbs are bought from growers and processing units in the regions where each plant grows best.

  2. 2

    Cleaning and drying

    Stones, stems and foreign matter are removed, and the material is dried until it is shelf-stable.

  3. 3

    Milling and sieving

    Dried material is ground and sieved to an even particle size, typically 60 to 80 mesh.

  4. 4

    Checking

    Every lot is checked for moisture, particle size, colour and aroma. Third-party lab reports are available on request.

  5. 5

    Packing

    Packed in food-grade liners inside 25 kg bags, each labelled with the product, lot number and packing date.

  6. 6

    Shipping

    Trucked from Pune to JNPT (Nhava Sheva) for sea freight, or to Mumbai air cargo, with export documents prepared.

Specifications, testing and documents

Shipping from Pune to your port

Pune is about 140 km from JNPT (Nhava Sheva), one of India’s busiest container ports, and a similar drive from Mumbai’s air cargo terminal. We prepare the export documents your customs broker will ask for.
